stock.description: Operating from its Hong Kong base, Victory Securities (Holdings) Company Limited is an investment holding enterprise that delivers a wide array of financial provisions. The firm specializes in brokerage services for equities, futures, and insurance policies, in addition to managing placements and underwriting. Its expertise also extends to securities guidance, comprehensive asset management, financial consultation, and advisory services concerning investments and insurance. Founded in 2016, the company maintains its principal office in Hong Kong and functions as a subsidiary of Dr. TT Kou's Family Company Limited.
